newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reuters photographer wins Walkley award.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reuters photographer wins Walkley award.

text.p: Mark Baker, Reuters chief photographer for Australia and New Zealand, on Thursday night won a Walkley award -- Australian journalism's highest honour - for best news photograph.
The award, presented in Sydney last night by New South Wales Premier Bob Carr, was for Baker's coverage of the anti-nuclear riots in Tahiti late last year.
Baker's pictures of rioters burning cars in Papeete appeared on front pages in newspapers in Australia and around the world.
"Mark Baker's 'Nuclear Fallout' captures a dramatic moment in a major news story and shows the news photographer's dedication and skill under pressure," the judges said.
"The menacing figure of a protester preparing to throw a stone symbolises the fury of Polynesians during French nuclear tsting in the Pacific," they said.
"The photograph tells the story about the big event, simply and directly."
Baker was a runner up last year for Australian Photographer of the Year Award.
